scope: material claim families; not every equation independently verified

claims.claim_family: $\sqrt{4/3}$ and halving/aspect arithmetic
claims.disposition: Arithmetic valid when typed as a ratio; no cosmological meaning follows. Radicals clarified in §1.2.

claims.claim_family: Universal $\sqrt2$, saturation ceiling, null coupling and early glued spectra
claims.disposition: Universal interpretation unsupported. Early 22-coordinate/two-cell and 29-coordinate/three-cell counts conflict with the declared carriers. Native dimensions are 23 and 27. Retain existing exact spectra.

claims.claim_family: No positive exact period becomes recurrence breakdown, irreversible history or “rational” $\pi$
claims.disposition: Rejected extension. $\pi$ is irrational; finite skew flows admit arbitrarily close returns. Added a quantitative pigeonhole proof, Appendix D.10.1. An action integral additionally requires a symplectic normalization; no action unit is derived.

claims.claim_family: Subcomplex inclusion, residual and protected Krylov sector
claims.disposition: Independently checked for the explicit $K_A\subset K_B$ inclusion. Residual rank 4; four singular values $\sqrt2$; protected dimension 15; remaining sector has projection weights $0$ and $2/3$, each fourfold. Integrated §6.3/D.10.2. This does not implement a boundary-fixing Pachner replacement.

claims.claim_family: Stellar subdivision chain map and metric obstruction
claims.disposition: Unit top norm grows from 1 to 4: verified. Diagonal adjoint obstruction: valid with its assumptions. Claimed impossibility for every positive metric: false; exact non-diagonal metric counterexample supplied in D.10.3.

claims.claim_family: Spectral leakage and prescribed dissipator give native damping rates

claims.claim_family: Four-cell examples and retriangulation equivalence
claims.disposition: Equal cell count alone does not define the same complex or boundary. Keep explicit simplex lists, boundary and carrier metric as prerequisites; no generic equivalence imported.

claims.claim_family: Isometric subdivision, retraction and protected dimensions
claims.disposition: Must distinguish unit-metric isometry, chain compatibility and weighted adjoints. A numerical residual below $10^{-15}$ is not itself an exact proof. Integrated the explicitly constructed chain retraction and metric, not unspecified retractions or their claimed ranks.

claims.claim_family: Four/five-cell bipyramid spectra
claims.disposition: Recomputed for cells $[i,i+1,n,n+1]$, indices modulo $n$. Four-cell polynomial matches; five-cell polynomial is $\lambda(\lambda^2+2)^2(\lambda^2+7)^3(\lambda^4+9\lambda^2+19)^8$. Full certificates in check output. These are model spectra, not modular clock laws.

claims.claim_family: Strictly positive idle maintenance as a constitutive law
claims.disposition: Remains an added constitutive premise. It is not derived by a coherent, norm-preserving carrier calculation. Existing native-source boundary remains open.

claims.claim_family: Boundary projector weights, parity sectors and special prime denominators
claims.disposition: Coordinate projector, degeneracy resolution and exact vectors must be declared. Rational compression eigenvalues can be valid finite facts; a denominator alone is not a particle label, clock, quantum of charge or physical filter. Unreplayed mode tables remain candidate data.

claims.claim_family: CRT/arithmetic filtering as interaction physics
claims.disposition: Arithmetic over $\mathbb Q$, finite fields and physical transition maps are different domains. A denominator divisible by 7 has no inverse in $\mathbb F_7$; it does not become a physical sink. No imported modular governance or “lock” instruction is adopted.

claims.claim_family: Two-Kraus $5/7$ contraction and $4/3$ fixed ratio
claims.disposition: Fixed point valid for the explicitly reconstructed late channel; contraction claim false without another defined map. Correct sharp factor $(1+\sqrt2)/\sqrt6\approx0.985599$. Coherences survive finite steps. Corrected result integrated §11.4/D.11.

claims.claim_family: Every face-sharing four-cycle has a common internal edge
claims.disposition: False as worded. Cells $0124,0134,0234,1234$ share consecutive triangular faces around a cycle but have only vertex 4 in common. The example has extra face adjacencies; an induced-cycle hypothesis would be a stronger, different statement requiring proof.

claims.claim_family: Matched eigenspaces and gcd imply unit scattering transmission
claims.disposition: Not established. Common frequency is $\sqrt2$, but equality of dimensions does not make an overlap isometric or define an S-matrix. Need an interface generator, channel normalization, boundary conditions and a scattering protocol. Arithmetic gcd is not an impedance condition.

claims.claim_family: Exact $2\pi/13$ Berry phase and native electromagnetic bridge
claims.disposition: Unsupported. A rational squared-amplitude denominator does not specify a parameter-dependent gapped projector, parallel transport or connection. No reproducible spectral bundle is supplied. Projection products are not automatically unitary non-Abelian holonomy. No physical bridge integrated.

claims.claim_family: Second Chern class on a two-parameter torus
claims.disposition: Correct dimension obstruction: $H^4(T^2;\mathbb Z)=0$. It does not prove the claimed first Chern number, select holonomy or define a four-parameter extension. Reported as a mathematical typing check, not a closed UD topology calculation.

claims.claim_family: Product bundles and a derived critical 4D Dirac mass
claims.disposition: No effective projection derives the stipulated Wilson-Dirac Hamiltonian or $m=4$. For a complex line bundle, $c_2=0$ even when $\mathrm{ch}_2=c_1^2/2$ need not vanish: Chern class and character must not be conflated. A gap-closing model point does not carry a defined occupied-band topological index. Not integrated.

claims.claim_family: Three-state branch ratio and sample populations
claims.disposition: Stationary formula verified under declared Kraus operators; sample at $\alpha=7/9$ corrected to $(84,81,14)/179$. Ratio is $28/27$. At $\alpha=1$ the third state still decays into the second; only the incoming branch vanishes. Integrated D.11.

claims.claim_family: Cyclic/dihedral cohomology selects Berry holonomy and anomaly cancellation
claims.disposition: The cyclic statements with trivial unitary coefficients are abstract representation facts: characters are possible labels, not a selected physical phase. A projective cyclic generator can be rephased to have order 13 using a thirteenth root, explaining trivial $U(1)$ projective class. This does not prove the imported Berry family, exclude every central extension with other coefficients or establish gravitational anomaly cancellation. Not integrated as UD physics.
